title: Physical Access and Facility Security
summary: Interpret defensive physical-security controls and restricted zones.
objectives: Describe controlled entrances, badges, visitors, and restricted areas.
Recognize physical-security risks without learning bypass methods.

vocab.def: An area limited to authorized identities.
A recorded attempt to use a physical access credential.
A controlled procedure for identifying and accompanying visitors.

sections.heading: Layered protection
sections.body: Entrances, badges, visitor processes, cameras, security staff, access logs, and restricted zones help protect facilities and assets.

sections.heading: Defensive only
sections.body: Do not bypass locks, clone badges, evade cameras, tailgate, defeat alarms, or test physical controls. Record suspicious conditions and escalate.

practice.prompt: A badge event appears outside the expected access window. What should a student do?
practice.answer: Record the event and escalate through the authorized security process.

quiz.question: What is a defensive physical-security practice?
options: Verify visitors through the official process
quiz.answer: Verify visitors through the official process

lab.objective: Interpret synthetic badge and visitor events.
